## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue or roadmap item it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ⚡ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update / translation
- [ ] 🛡️ Security / Governance enhancement

## Verification & DoD Checklist
- [ ] All code changes are covered by automated unit tests in `server/tests/`.
- [ ] Ran full pytest suite: all tests passed with 100% green.
- [ ] No hardcoded machine-specific absolute paths introduced.
- [ ] Documentation and/or CHANGELOG updated if applicable.
